title: Hearty French Potatoes Macaron
description: A cultured and aerated French dish featuring floury potatoes in a macaron form, served in a scallop shell, perfect for a special occasion, this recipe is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, flour, and melted butter, mix until the potatoes are well coated.
In a separate bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Add the grated cheese, salt, and sugar to the egg whites, mix until well combined.
Gently fold the egg mixture into the potato mixture until just combined.
Spoon the mixture into a piping bag fitted with a large round tip.
Pipe the mixture into scallop shells, filling them about 3/4 of the way full.
Tap the shells gently to remove any air bubbles.
Place the shells on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
